label: feature
file: src/exportUtils.ts

Thanks for the report! TSV isn't currently supported — exports are limited to CSV and XLSX, defined via `SUPPORTED_FORMATS`/`ExportFormat` in src/exportUtils.ts and dispatched in `renderExport` (src/api/reports.ts), which calls `writeCsv`/`writeXlsx` from src/export/. Adding TSV would mean adding a `"tsv"` variant there plus a `writeTsv` writer (likely a small variant of src/export/csv.ts using tab as the delimiter), and wiring it into the export route and scheduler. Filing this as a feature request against the export format list.

input.title: Add TSV export format alongside CSV and XLSX
input.body: File: src/exportUtils.ts. Add "tsv" to the SUPPORTED_FORMATS list (and ExportFormat type) so reports can be exported as tab-delimited files, which the warehouse loader requires. A corresponding writeTsv function (likely reusing the CSV writer logic with a tab delimiter) should be wired into the export dispatch in src/api/reports.ts, but the format should be declared and validated starting in exportUtils.ts.
